column7: Use a box to reach top, fight gravity down. Builds pull-up strength rapidly.

Notes: Shoulders packed, touch dumbbells to chest. No bouncing.

Light weight, lead with elbows. Don't swing.
Full stretch at bottom, controlled curl.
